name: Bent Finance

descriptions.text: Who has been bending the rules at Bent Finance? ~$1.75M taken. Inspector rekt sets things straight.

The staking and yield farming platform Bent Finance tweeted that the Bent Deployer wallet upgraded the curve pool contract from November 30, 2021 to 2021 01:09:27 PM +UTC, and the exploiter added a malicious contract that made cvxcrv and cvxcrv and The mim pool is able to hardcode user balances and then deploy another contract to mask it. The attackers stole a total of 513,000 cvxcrv LP tokens. Bent Finance later updated the incident report saying that with the help of two white hat hackers, the team analyzed the incident and concluded: "This was actually the work of an 'inside member'. After several days of hacking, the attackers finally agreed to ret…

Bent Finance was exploited in December 2021 via an insider contract update on Ethereum. A privileged deployer address assigned an unjustified reward balance, enabling fraudulent withdrawals of cvxCRV and ETH totaling up to $1.75M. Most assets were returned and users reimbursed, though no direct transaction or code evidence is published. A privileged deployer address manually assigned a large, fabricated token balance in a contract update. Poor access controls, incomplete multisig migration, and lack of public audit enabled fraudulent reward claims.
